chunks.content: # CLO's First BILIBILI Live Stream Replay (2020-02-21) This document presents a detailed walkthrough of CLO Virtual Fashion’s 3D garment design software, including product overview, garment creation processes, fabric and texture management, and platform integration. It also covers technical features, user instructions, and answers to common user questions, optimized for semantic search and embedding. --- ## Introduction to CLO Virtual Fashion and Products This section introduces CLO Virtual Fashion, its main products, company background, and core capabilities in 3D fashion design and simulation technology. - **Company:** CLO Virtual Fashion, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with six global branches. - **Main Products:** - **CLO 3D:** Focused on fashion design and garment simulation. - **Marvelous Designer:** Another 3D clothing design tool by CLO. - **Core Technology:** Advanced 3D fashion simulation showcasing realistic fabric behavior, folds, seams, and internal fabric structures. - **Key Features:** - Realistic simulation of clothing layers, cuts, colors, and details. -
